channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Historic Eagle Lake schoolhouse spared from demolition after community fight
item.description: For months, Eagle Lake residents have been fighting to save a historic schoolhouse from demolition. Now the work to preserve the 100-year-old building is just beginning.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Psychologist testifies Lindsay Clancy was not criminally responsible in killing of her 3 children
item.description: Lindsay Clancy didn’t appreciate the “wrongfulness” of killing her three children because of her mental health issues, a psychologist testifying for the defense said at her murder trial Wednesday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New citrus groves at Florida Southern College aims to help growers fight industry decline
item.description: Florida’s citrus industry has taken a major hit from disease and other challenges, but one Lakeland college is trying to help grow a better future.

item.description: President Donald Trump announced severe new economic sanctions against Iran on Wednesday, but did not go into immediate detail.

item.description: President Trump expects to meet with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un later this year, after directing the U.S. military to scale down joint exercises with South Korea.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] City of Tampa highlights backyard 'ADUs' amid high housing costs, affordability challenges
item.description: On Wednesday, the city of Tampa highlighted accessory dwelling units – often called ADUs – as a potential option to fight high housing costs and the housing affordability crisis.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk County deputies crack down on saw palmetto berry thefts
